newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Japan supports U.S. revision of defence guidelines by including Taiwan, South Korea and Spratlys as areas under U.S. and Japan defence
Taiwan president says not to give up or reduce pork export
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan may levy income tax on military servicemen and teachers
Taiwan president orders continued pork exports
LIBERTY TIMES - Three arrested for allegedly smuggling narcotics from China via defence outpost of Kinmen
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Formosa Plastics group to increase investment in high-tech industry
Taiwan to ease restrictions on labour insurance, pension funds' investment in stock market
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank alerts stock investors on investment risks
U.S. dollar continues to rise, yen depreciates
